feed.title: NPR Topics: Home Page Top Stories
feed.subtitle: Top stories in the U.S. and world news, politics, health, science, business, music, arts and culture. Nonprofit journalism with a mission. This is NPR.

entry.title: Lebanese villagers return to wrecked homes as the Israeli army pulls back
entry.summary: In a pilot project in a village in southern Lebanon, Israeli forces have left and the Lebanese army moved it. But villagers who return find their houses wrecked.

entry.title: Meet the young authors! A literacy program inspires kids in South Africa
entry.summary: South Africa is working to overcome a children's literacy crisis. In one Johannesburg township, a reading club is instilling a love of books in kids — and inspiring them to become authors.

entry.title: Climate change talks fall apart in final hours over fossil fuels
entry.summary: Some 200 countries gathered in Antalya, Turkey, for COP31, the annual climate negotiations. Countries failed to reach an agreement over fossil fuels - the primary driver of global warming.

entry.title: Medicare looks a bit different in 2027, so don't miss open enrollment
entry.summary: Open enrollment for Medicare runs through Dec. 7, and there are a few different pitfalls people should watch out for this year. Your drug plan or Medicare Advantage plan could be changing a lot.

entry.title: He expected a small-business loan. He got a 7-year nightmare
entry.summary: America's fastest-growing source of funding for small businesses is also one of the least regulated. One man has waged a long, lonely fight to recoup its punishing cost.

entry.title: NPR's Senior Podcast Challenge: Early entries we love
entry.summary: People 65 and older have been submitting stories for a chance to win our grand prize — a visit to NPR watch your podcast air live on Weekend Edition. There's still time to enter!

entry.title: Paolo Bulgari, who turned a family jewelry business into a global brand, dies at 89
entry.summary: The Italian jewelry magnate led the Bulgari brand through decades of international expansion, building its reputation for bold gemstones, distinctive designs and Italian glamour.

entry.title: Trump orders federal contractors to check with White House before responding to Congress
entry.summary: President Trump is directing federal contractors to consult the White House about inquiries from Congress and to withhold any communications that his administration considers privileged.

entry.title: Bayer reaches Roundup settlement that could cost the company billions
entry.summary: The money will go to thousands of people who have been or will be diagnosed with non-Hodgkin lymphoma – a blood cancer linked to the herbicide.

entry.title: Storms expected on both coasts threaten Thanksgiving travel
entry.summary: The mayor of San Francisco is asking people in the city not to travel unless "absolutely essential." Meanwhile, a storm moving up the Eastern seaboard could also cause travel delays ahead of Thanksgiving.
